name: Home Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Home Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Home Bank, National Association that provides various banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas, the United States. The company offers deposit products, including interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing checking, money market, savings, NOW, and certificates of deposit accounts; custodial accounts; health savings and individual retirement accounts; and statement savings. It also provides various loan products comprising one-to four-family first mortgage loans, home equity loans and lines, commercial real estate loans, construction and land loans, multi-family residential loans,…
